body: The streetlights flickered dimly in my rearview mirror. The road became more winding as I accelerated through the deserted parking lot. Panic surged through me like a tidal wave—anger, fear, even some sense of urgency to escape. My heart pounded so loud in my chest that for a moment, I could barely hear my own breath.
